definition: the hearer sends what the slot names to the speaker
literal structure: (situation give ITERATIVE (EVENT-TIME AFTER NOW) (ACTOR (term INTERLOCUTOR)) (UNDERGOER (slot 1)) (RECIPIENT (term SELF)))
pragmatic conditions: in a request naming a message the speaker lost or could not read
constructed history: Constructed history: an agent that had lost what it was given asked for it to be given again, and the request kept its repetition in its words.
